pages.name: Vodianytsia
pages.text: A river dweller that looks like a tiny mermaid. Do not trust her looks.

pages.title: The song
pages.text: The vodianytsias’ song inflicts $(thing)Lure$(): you cannot jump, and the water pulls you in. The range is $(thing)32 blocks$().$(br2)In the water you cannot swim up: you are pressed to the bottom.

pages.title: What to do
pages.text: $(#2E7D4F)The best escape is Spirit Form.$() Switch it on as soon as you feel the pull of the water.$(br2)Vodianytsias are timid and weak, but a quarter of them are bold: they swim up and attack when you are already drowning.
